purpose: Explicit exemptions for parent-code references into the vendored openclaw_runtime tree that cannot resolve in a source checkout, required by issue #93 ("existence-checked or explicitly exempted"). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; the guard fails closed on any dangling reference that is not listed here.
howToAdd: Add { file, target, reason } where target may use '*' wildcards. Prefer fixing the reference. A stale entry (one that no longer matches any reference) is reported as INFO and never fails the check.

entries.reason: Runtime build output captured only after seven successful build receipts; capture-resource-builds recursively reads and hashes this directory and fails if it is missing. Produced by pnpm run build:runtime; not a source input available before that build.

Built SDK probe deliberately imports and hashes the emitted knowledge-retrieval facade after pnpm run build:runtime. Its runtime import/readFile fails when the artifact is absent; source-only checks run before the build.
Runtime build inventory for trial receipts, produced by pnpm run build:runtime; the trial path builds and archives output hashes. This directory is not a tracked source dependency.

Bundled extension runtime output inventoried with dist for trial build receipts. Runtime build creates it; archived output identities are checked by the trial validator rather than requiring generated files before build.
Generated runtime build stamp read after building and rechecked against the archived trial receipt. Missing or changed stamps fail the trial checks; a clean source checkout has no stamp.
Soak validation hashes the runtime build directory and requires the emitted entry before execution. Produced by pnpm run build:runtime, not a tracked source tree.
Runtime soak entry generated by pnpm run build:runtime. The soak runner explicitly requires the built entry; absence remains an execution error after build preparation.
A2 build identity hashes this generated runtime entry after validating a successful build:runtime receipt. fileInfo rejects missing files; source validation precedes that build.
A2 build identity hashes the generated SEKB facade from pnpm run build:runtime. fileInfo rejects a missing artifact; it is not expected in an unbuilt source checkout.
A2 build identity binds the generated public extension wrapper from pnpm run build:runtime and rejects missing bytes through fileInfo. No source path is being exempted.
A2 build identity binds the bundled extension output alongside its dist wrapper after a successful build. fileInfo still rejects absence; runtime build owns this generated path.

Generated BENCHMARK_SCRIPT text, piped to `tsx -` with cwd = repo root, so its `./openclaw_runtime/...` specifier resolves against the repo root rather than against scripts/. Verified by reading the spawn call (cwd: ROOT, input: BENCHMARK_SCRIPT).
Build output, produced by `pnpm run build:runtime`; a source checkout legitimately has no dist/ tree. The script hashes the file at run time and fails on its own when the build is missing.

PREREQUISITE_PATHS is the expected file set of the historical diff PREREQUISITE_DIFF_BASE..PREREQUISITE_COMMIT (c860c12f4), compared against `git diff --name-only` for that range, not against the working tree. The path existed in that range and was later renamed; existence must be judged against the pinned commit. The list length is also pinned (38), so it must not be edited to silence this guard.
